name: Hybrid Implicit Neural Representation SLAM Sampling & Optimization
definition: A real-time RGB-D SLAM framework that optimizes an implicit neural representation using hybrid spatial encodings (dense grid or hash grid combined with tri-planes) and a composite loss function, with ray sampling tailored for tracking and mapping iterations.
summary: This real-time RGB-D SLAM method accelerates high-accuracy scene reconstruction by jointly optimizing camera poses and an implicit neural representation using hybrid spatial encodings like dense or hash grids with tri-planes.
